opencv.reason: OpenCV.js exports solvePnPRansac, solvePnPRefineLM, projectPoints, ORB, AKAZE, BFMatcher, and optical flow.

opencvMobile.reason: Lean mobile/WebAssembly build reference. Stock package excludes calib3d/opencv_js, so this repo borrows the build philosophy rather than consuming it directly.

emscripten.reason: Known stable Emscripten baseline for OpenCV.js style builds.
